scripts.title: CanHub | Auto Escape, Auto Inf Stamina, SafeZone, & More
scripts.features: This script provides a comprehensive set of quality-of-life and accessibility enhancements for navigating the game world more effectively. It includes visual indicators that highlight important objects such as the active threat, required tools, puzzle cubes, locked doors, and unsearched cabinets, making objectives easier to locate at a glance. Users can also adjust the in-game lighting to remove darkness, fog, and shadows for clearer visibility, or switch to a third-person camera for a wider field of view. A proximity alert system and optional automatic upward movement help players avoid dangerous encounters when the main enemy approaches. Automation features allow for instant interactions, automatic pickup of key items, automatic searching of nearby cabinets, and even one-click solving of cube puzzles. Movement options include adjustable running speed, unlimited stamina, the ability to pass through solid objects, and a fly mode with configurable speed. Additional utilities like a live performance overlay, anti-idle protection, server rejoin button, and a reset for the cabinet tracking cache round out the package. The interface is fully customizable with theme and save management, and a small draggable button lets you toggle the main panel and view real-time ping and session duration.
